overview: Host Danielle Balocca provided an update on the city's charter review process before interviewing local teacher and podcaster Anthony Petrelis. The discussion highlighted the impact of youth athletics in Medford and the development of the Beyond Podcast.

items.title: Charter Review Update
items.summary: Danielle Balocca announced that the Committee of the Whole meeting to discuss the Home Rule petition was cancelled and promoted an upcoming Medford Charter Review Coalition meeting.

items.title: Interview with Anthony Petrelis
items.summary: Anthony Petrelis introduced himself as a teacher at McGlynn Elementary and a lifelong Medford resident who hosts a sports-focused podcast.

items.title: Beyond Podcast Development
items.summary: Petrelis described starting his podcast during the pandemic to give coaches and student-athletes a positive platform for showcasing their programs through interviews and game coverage.

items.title: Youth Athletics and Community Impact
items.summary: The discussion focused on how sports participation fosters discipline, time management, and academic balance for Medford students.

items.title: Future Plans and Charitable Initiatives
items.summary: Petrelis outlined plans for expanding coverage to lacrosse and softball, as well as his efforts to fund communication boards for students with autism through the Flutie Foundation.
